desc: Ideate approaches and select closed-form capped factorial unranking as the primary method.
Precompute capped factorials up to n and implement count_completions(odd_left, even_left, next_parity) using parity-position matching with all counts capped above 1e15.

Implement greedy unranking in Solution.permute by maintaining unused odd/even values, scanning candidates in increasing order, subtracting block sizes from k, and fixing the chosen value at each position.
Compute the total number of valid alternating permutations and return an empty list if k is out of range.
Handle edge cases explicitly, including n = 1, n = 2, odd n, even n, and k near 1e15.
